items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: he got Don Sebesky on it, and of course Don Sebesky contributed such a tremendous amount, because he came up with a lot of the ideas and did all these big charts orchestrating

ctx.x: And we’ve still got all this energy — let me tell you about — hey but I—

He was for it right away. And then he got Don Sebesky on it, and of course Don Sebesky contributed such a tremendous amount, because he came up with a lot of the ideas and did all these big charts orchestrating, and of course there were a couple of Roy’s things in there too but he orchestrated everything for a 70 piece orchestra. And it was just, I mean it was thrilling to do it.
You had the cream of the — the best.
